participant_protocol.design: draft within-subject counterbalanced assignment across five visualization families
participant_protocol.assignment: P01-P05 seeded rotation; each participant receives one condition per task and each task is covered once per condition across the pilot template
participant_protocol.oracle_visibility: participants see only assigned condition packets; oracle_sources and answer keys are for graders
participant_protocol.readiness_boundary: draft: content leakage and assignment checks pass, but baseline fairness still needs a same-event-slice audit before collecting participants
participant_protocol.claim_gate: C5 can move beyond unsupported only after scored participant responses exist.

tasks.title: Top Nonsemantic System Mixing
tasks.question: Which high-weight nonsemantic system bucket is dominated by which semantic region?
tasks.baseline_contrast: Trace/span/flat views show activity but do not expose the semantic split inside this repeated bucket.

tasks.title: Prompt Axis Contribution
tasks.question: How much does prompt-only projection reduce system-effect mixing compared with no semantic axis?
tasks.baseline_contrast: A nonsemantic flamegraph aggregates repeated work but cannot quantify which semantic axis reduced mixing.

tasks.title: Session Versus Prompt Axis
tasks.question: Which single semantic axis separates system effects better: session or prompt?
tasks.baseline_contrast: This task isolates mechanism: prompt tags carry most system-effect separation in the current corpus.

tasks.title: Heaviest Repeated Semantic Stack
tasks.question: Identify the heaviest semantic system stack and its semantic/effect fields.
tasks.baseline_contrast: A flat summary can reveal volume, but the semantic stack names the task region causing it.

tasks.title: Heaviest Path-Specific Read
tasks.question: Find the heaviest path-specific system-effect stack and report process, path, and semantic tags.
tasks.baseline_contrast: Traditional file summaries can find a hot path, but not the prompt/session region that caused it.

tasks.title: Cargo Test Semantic Split

tasks.baseline_contrast: The baseline can name the command/effect bucket; semantic aggregation identifies the task split.

tasks.title: Flat Git Read Baseline Failure
tasks.question: In the flat git/read bucket, which semantic region dominates?

tasks.title: Largest Token Region
tasks.question: Identify the largest token stack and report its semantic/token fields.
tasks.baseline_contrast: Token cost views need semantic frames to explain which task region consumed the token mass.

tasks.title: LLM-Call Axis Boundary
tasks.question: Does prompt+LLM-call alone fully explain token provenance, and what residual remains?
tasks.baseline_contrast: This guards against overclaiming LLM-call tags as system-effect attribution axes.

tasks.title: Exact-Lineage Negative Controls
tasks.question: For the R114 exact-lineage suite, report scoped join and negative-control outcomes.
tasks.baseline_contrast: Span traces show execution; exact provenance checks whether system effects inherit the right agent ancestry.

tasks.title: Raw Join Versus Scoped Recall
tasks.question: Why is R114 raw join much lower than scoped recall, and what are the key numbers?
tasks.baseline_contrast: This task tests whether users avoid confusing raw coverage with scoped lineage recall.

tasks.title: 3B Tag Stability Boundary
tasks.question: Report the real-fragment 3B tag-stability numbers and the correct claim boundary.
tasks.baseline_contrast: This is a boundary task: stable one-word tags do not prove human adequacy.
